Rudra gave 2 unaided correct responses for this skill.

Zero-counting in examples such as 3,000 × 400 remained mixed and was not corrected after the last observed error.

end.parentNote: Asha practised breaking zero-ending products into non-zero parts and then counting the zeros, as well as rounding factors to estimate products. Rudra used the non-zero-part method correctly in two responses and explained some zero-counting steps aloud. There was still a mix-up when counting zeros in larger products, and it was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, practise a few examples such as 30 × 40 and 3,000 × 400 by writing the non-zero multiplication and counting all trailing zeros separately.
